extension.reason: cole_anchor.json grew to 6 cases under the chain-3 study, while the chain-2 artifacts were generated for 4; the missing cases were recomputed through the chain-2 code path instead of leaving the published artifacts short of the anchor ensemble

reproduction_check.note: a published case is recomputed through the same code path; agreement to 1e-9 relative is what licenses merging the new cases into the same table

extension.chain_metrics_note: chain_metrics.json stays the mission-15095 (C1-C4) provenance record and is not rewritten here; its recorded anchor_sha256 predates the 6-case anchor

gci_correction.what: the gci_* and gci_pass columns of every row were recomputed as roache_gci(fine, medium, coarse) from the three-level values recorded in grid_convergence.json
gci_correction.why: the chain-2 driver passed the levels coarse->fine into a signature that expects the fine level first; that flips the sign of the observed order, which is then clipped to the lower bound 0.5, so every published GCI was inflated; a quantity whose three levels do not demonstrate convergence was written as 0 instead of n/a
gci_correction.log_is_a_fixed_record: before values are the literal chain-2 publication, not re-read from the file, so a second run logs the same correction

cross_check_vs_own_solves.note: the gci columns are recomputed from the three-level values recorded by the chain-3 driver; for the cases solved here the same levels are reproduced from an independent run

gci_correction.not_changed: no physics column moves: peaks, impulses, deflections, energy residuals and SRS entries are the published values (see reproduction_check)
